section.title: Classification
section.copy: Optional: how this asset is categorised.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.hint: Stored as written, so a URL keeps its path.

fields.name: scope
fields.label: Scope
fields.hint: A private address repeats across sites. Name the network.

fields.name: hash
fields.label: Hash
fields.hint: What identifies the file. A filename alone can match another binary.

section.title: Scale
section.copy: Approximate is what the regulations ask for — a false precision is worse than a range.

section.title: Where it was
section.copy: The host or service holding it. The route it took is a timeline entry.

fields.name: instance
fields.label: Instance
fields.hint: Two tenants of one application are two rows.

section.title: Chain of custody
section.copy: Who took it, when, and how it is known to be unchanged.

section.title: What this is evidence of
section.copy: Optional: the asset or account this record covers.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.hint: What a reader will see cited beside a claim.

section.title: Where it ran
section.copy: Named so a reader knows which console to open. Nothing here is resolved.

section.title: What was run
section.copy: Kept exactly as it was run. Nothing here is rewritten or normalised.

section.title: What it covered, and what came back
section.copy: Stated, never read out of the query: a relative window moves.

fields.name: rowsReturned
fields.label: Rows returned (as recorded)
fields.hint: The app did not run the query, so this is what a person recorded.

fields.name: resultExcerpt
fields.label: Result or transcript
fields.hint: Optional. Most acts have no transcript, and the row is complete without one.

section.title: The story so far
section.copy: What happened, in the words the report will open with.
